items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the derived Hom against a bimodule T satisfying compactness and representability hypotheses with the derived tensor by the dual S (statement lines 5782-5798). The proof (lines 5800-5834) is a genuine adjunction-building argument: the bimodule structure and the counit-type multiplication, the transport to derived functors through property-(P) and property-(I) replacements, and the two-step compactness reduction through finite filtrations down to the shift case where assumption (2) is exactly the claim. H2: the reduction architecture and the way the hypothesis lands on the final case carry the proof.
